newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GWA expects earnings rise in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: GWA expects earnings rise in 96/97.

text.p: GWA International Ltd chairman Barry Thornton said on Wednesday he expected the company to increase its profits in the year to June 30, 1997 despite some negative economic conditions.

"Despite difficult trading conditions we still expect profitability conditions to continue," Thornton told a media briefing in Brisbane. "We are looking for an increase in profits in the current year, but there are economic negatives."
Thornton said trading conditions in the current year so far had been very difficult.
